messages:
Maya: Heads-up - after pulling latest node SDK into the sampleapp the request IDs are missing from debug logs when LOG_LEVEL=verbose. Repro on macbook. :eyes:
Sam: I can repro locally too. Only happens when OpenTelemetry is enabled; non-OTEL runs keep x-request-id in logs.
Irene: Which SDK version? I thought we fixed the redact-on-verbose quirk last week.
Maya: Using @redwood/sdk-node v0.12.4. I bisected to the otel hook change that introduced async header normalization.
Sam: Repro snippet:
```js
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').otelHook())
app.use(require('redwood-telemetry').logHook())
```
Sam: When otelHook runs first, logHook sometimes logs before the request-id is copied into context on retries. With retry middleware you see blank reqid fields.
Maya: Also with REDACT_SENSITIVE=true the header key `x-request-id` is sometimes removed from req object during retry flow. New behavior.
Irene: Sounds like a race between async otel init and sync logger middleware. Are we awaiting otel init anywhere?
Ajay: In hook code otelHook does: `getContext().then(c => setReqIdFromHeaders(c))` while logHook reads `req.ctx.reqId` sync. If promise hasn't resolved we log empty.
Maya: My repro steps: clone sampleapp, `LOG_LEVEL=verbose REDACT_SENSITIVE=true OTEL_ENABLED=1 npm start`, then `for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/text -d '{"q":"x"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'; done` and check stdout. Deterministic for me.
Sam: Quick workaround: initialize telemetry before mounting logHook, e.g. `await telemetry.initialize()` during startup.
Ajay: Pushed tiny PR with two options: 1) make otelHook init sync at bootstrap, or 2) make logHook fallback to `req.headers['x-request-id']` if ctx missing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/199 :thumbsup:
Irene: Prefer making otel init sync-like but be careful about startup blocking in Private deployment.
Maya: Added failing test case and logs to the issue.
telemetry-bot: New issue TW-5412 created "node sdk: reqid disappears when OTEL + verbose logs + retries" linked to PR #199.
devdeploy: Can we gate the hosted samples deploy? don't want onboarding to break for new users.
Ajay: I'll add a feature flag and migration note. If CI passes we'll merge behind the flag and flip after smoke tests.
Sam: Thanks for quick triage.
Maya: I'll upload the failing run and sampleapp branch to the ticket. :coffee:
